confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from three web searches. One was the RBA FX lookup, and two were cost-of-living searches that returned aggregator pages and a Buenos Aires Herald article. Those sources are partly dated, quote prices in pesos or in USD figures that disagree with each other, and Argentine inflation and the peso/USD rate move fast. For example, beer ranged from about ARS 3,500 to 6,000, and the mid-range meal for two was a peso figure from a July 2025 table. I converted these myself at a rough, uncertain peso rate and set the anchors in the middle of the plausible USD range. I found no recent cocktail price. The cocktail anchor is set at roughly 2x the beer price, and the wine glass at roughly 1.4x beer, based on typical local relationships. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Buenos Aires tourism pricing. I did not search for or inspect any booking pages or listings. They are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Buenos Aires itself using the searched price sources. Regionally it sits between Santiago and Montevideo for tourist-area pricing, and it is cheaper than Santiago for accommodation.
